# Every routing-policy example in RFC 2622, RFC 2650 and RFC 4012, as written
# (a value continued over several lines is joined into one). Grammar templates
# such as "from <peering-1> [action <action-1>]" are left out, and three values
# split by a page break or a hyphenated line are rejoined by hand.
# TestRFCExamples parses each and expects no diagnostic, or the rules after
# "## expect:".
